reason: run-all attempt 2 (2026-09-20) halted at infer-confirm: RuntimeError "the recheck Direct score 'risk_by_seed' does not equal the formal risk scores' leading slice". Root cause (probe-verified on the existing formal artifacts, read-only): the frozen Direct scoring path (stage4cr2_training.score_models -> stage4cp_models.predict_decision_risk -> DirectRiskModel.forward) runs the whole design matrix in ONE unbatched CUDA forward, so the cuBLAS GEMM kernel selection (float32 accumulation order) depends on the row count M. The formal inference scored M=2000 groups; the 32-group determinism recheck scored M=32. Probe: recheck-vs-formal leading slices were bitwise EQUAL for all predictions (6 keys x 5 pairs), all 5 risk classes, all 4 baselines, constant_random, t_star, interaction_min_distance, reference_action, valid_mask and group_seed; ONLY the Direct arrays diverged at float32 ULP level (risk_by_seed 146/160 elements, max 5.992e-08; risk_ensemble 32/32, max 1.769e-08; mu_only_ensemble max 2.117e-07; class_only_ensemble max 9.119e-08; all five seeds affected). Scoring the same 32 groups' tokens zero-padded to the formal M=2000 and slicing back reproduces the formal leading slice BITWISE for risk_by_seed, risk_ensemble, mu_only_ensemble and class_only_ensemble. The repair context-aligns ONLY the recheck; the formal inference path and its create-once artifacts are untouched.
